settings.title: Service Clinic
Discover Kara
settings.text: Since entering the glass machinery and door and window industry, Kara has continually worked to meet the needs of professionals in this field by offering a comprehensive range of standard, fully equipped, and export-grade machinery for the production of double-glazed glass and doors and windows.

settings.title: Kara’s History
settings.text: Kara began its operations in ۱۳۸۴ in the fields of double-glazed glass and UPVC door and window assembly. In response to the Iranian market’s growing demand for modern machinery, the company began importing advanced double-glazing and UPVC equipment in ۱۳۸۸. It subsequently started manufacturing selected machines in accordance with international standards.

settings.title: Kara’s Fields of Activity
settings.text: As one of Iran’s most comprehensive providers of machinery for double-glazed glass production and UPVC and aluminium door and window manufacturing, Kara Group offers more than 50 products and is ready to serve its valued customers.

settings.title: Kara’s Achievements
settings.text:
A leading manufacturer of double-glazing and UPVC machinery in ۱۳۹۸–۱۳۹۹.
The first manufacturer in the country of fully equipped glass-washing machines, wide-format low-noise washing machines, and automatic double-head welding and cutting machines.

settings.title: Kara’s Vision
settings.text: By attending leading international trade fairs and acquiring modern knowledge and technology, Kara’s senior management continually works to improve the quality of its machinery and products.
